title: Clorox recognized as one of America’s Most Innovative Large Companies
summary: Clorox has been recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Most Innovative Large Companies, highlighting the company’s consumer-led innovation, R&D strength and commitment to creating superior products and experiences.
body_markdown:
Forbes created its new ranking to recognize large companies that continue to reinvent themselves and push their industries forward.


In recent years, Clorox has strengthened how we innovate by transforming our innovation engine to move faster and focus on bigger opportunities. Through investments in new capabilities, digital tools and ways of working, we have tripled the number of products moving through our innovation pipeline, cut innovation discovery time in half and sharpened our focus on superior consumer experiences. These advances are helping Clorox bring more meaningful innovation to consumers with greater speed and impact.


“For Clorox teammates, this honor reinforces something we strive to deliver every day: big, bold innovation that creates superior, delightful consumer experiences and category-leading growth. Whether it’s creating superior products, uncovering new consumer insights, advancing digital capabilities, building stronger brands, strengthening intellectual property or finding smarter ways to operate, innovation lives with everyone at Clorox and is helping fuel our next chapter of growth,” Mark added.
